image.rights: Retailer/brand image used for a student concept with attribution; public or commercial reuse not confirmed

products.servings_note: Not stated on card; nutrition given 'Per Pack'.
products.description: Succulent chicken breast pieces, coconut pilau rice and quinoa simmered in a butter masala sauce
products.ingredients: Pilau Rice (32%) [Water, Basmati Rice, Garlic Purée, Ginger Purée, Spices, Salt], Chicken Breast (28%), Water, Tomatoes, Onions, CREAM (MILK), Tomato Paste, Vegetable Oils (Rapeseed, Sunflower), Spices, Natural Yoghurt (MILK), Butter (MILK), Garlic Purée, Ginger Purée, Skimmed MILK Powder, Starch, White Quinoa, Sugar, Honey, Desiccated Coconut, Salt, Herbs, MUSTARD Powder, Maltodextrin, Garlic Powder, Ginger Powder, Yeast Extract, Colours (Paprika Extract, Plain Caramel), Parsnip Powder, Onion Powder, Ground CELERY
products.safety_warning: Although every care has been taken to remove all bones, some may remain.
products.storage: Keep refrigerated at 0°C to 5°C. Once opened, keep refrigerated and consume within 1 day. Do not exceed the use by date shown on front of pack. Suitable for home freezing. Freeze by use by date shown and consume within 1 month. Defrost thoroughly before use. Once defrosted (in a refrigerator) consume within 1 day. Do not refreeze.
